name: GuideLink
description: Keeps canonical IPTV channels aligned, reports availability, and guards scrubber/failover continuity.

fields.label: Profile Name
fields.helper_text: Friendly name shown when assigning this profile to playlists.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.helper_text: Disabled profiles stay saved but are ignored by setup, reports, sync, and schedules.

fields.label: Alias Sets
fields.helper_text: Optional shared channel aliases from Data → Alias Sets. Sets must use this profile’s country; targets must exist in its guide.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Choose where GuideLink gets canonical channel data and how fresh that source must be.

fields.label: Guide EPG
fields.helper_text: Required numbered guide EPG used to validate channel numbers and supply consistent stream IDs for auto-merge.

fields.label: Country
fields.helper_text: Country rules control aliases, exclusions, and provider/source compatibility.

fields.label: Provider
fields.helper_text: Registry-backed provider family. Choices update from the selected country.

fields.label: Provider Source
fields.helper_text: Canonical source for the selected provider and country.

fields.label: Region
fields.helper_text: Provider region number or exact region name. For Sky, region 7 is Granada.

fields.label: Source Mode
fields.helper_text: Use scraper cache for registry-backed sources, or native playlist when another playlist is the source of truth.

fields.label: Source Playlist
fields.helper_text: Required only when Source Mode is native playlist.

fields.label: Scraping API
fields.helper_text: Backend used to fetch source pages. API-backed scrapers help with pages that block direct HTTP.

fields.label: Scraping API Key
fields.helper_text: Required for scrape.do and OloStep. Enter the API key here; Direct HTTP does not require one.

fields.label: Scraping Timeout Seconds
fields.helper_text: Per-page HTTP timeout. A refresh fetches both region map and channel pages.

fields.label: Source Cache Days
fields.helper_text: Maximum age for parsed source cache. Use 0 to fetch every time.

fields.label: Max Retries
fields.helper_text: Attempts per source page before falling back to the parsed last-good cache.

fields.label: Minimum Source Channels
fields.helper_text: Rejects suspiciously small parsed source output before it replaces cache.

fields.label: Maximum Drop Percent
fields.helper_text: Refuses to replace last-good cache when parsed channel count drops too far.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Limit which playlist channels GuideLink evaluates and which groups it may rewrite.

fields.label: Include Scrubber Logs
fields.helper_text: Include scrubber health context in availability and repair reports when available.

fields.label: Include Managed Source Groups
fields.helper_text: Allow source categories and managed groups to be included in scope and created during apply.

fields.label: Quarantine Unmanaged Provider Groups After Matching
fields.helper_text: Disables channels remaining in unmanaged provider groups after matching. Keep off unless explicitly desired.

fields.label: Include Group Prefixes
fields.helper_text: Leave empty to consider all groups. Enter prefixes to limit scope; exclusions and preserved groups still apply.

fields.label: Exclude Group Regex
fields.helper_text: Regex patterns for groups to exclude even when their prefix matches.

fields.label: Preserve Groups
fields.helper_text: Exact group names that GuideLink must never move or rewrite.

fields.label: Preserve Group Name Regex
fields.helper_text: Regex patterns for group names GuideLink must never move or rewrite.

fields.label: Preserve Channel Title Regex
fields.helper_text: Regex patterns for channel titles GuideLink must never rewrite.

fields.label: Native Setup
fields.description: Desired m3u-editor auto-merge and scrubber setup for playlists using this profile.

fields.label: Auto-Merge Preferred Playlist
fields.helper_text: Preferred source of primary streams when merging playlists. Defaults to this playlist. Catch-up preference and resolution can take priority.

fields.label: Backup Playlists
fields.helper_text: Choose additional backup playlists in priority order. Leave empty to use only the assigned playlist.

fields.label: Deactivate Failover Channels
fields.helper_text: Hidden-failover policy. Auto-merge disables backup channels after master selection, and GuideLink uses the same policy to keep the scrubber from re-exposing them.

fields.label: Merge Only New Channels
fields.helper_text: Enable only when native auto-merge should skip rebuilding existing failover topology.

fields.label: Force Complete Re-Merge
fields.helper_text: Rebuild native failover topology fully when applying native setup.

fields.label: Auto-Merge Key
fields.helper_text: Native merge key used to identify matching live-channel failovers.

fields.label: Prioritize By Resolution
fields.helper_text: Prefer higher-resolution streams during native primary selection. Uses stream statistics and may probe streams when needed.

fields.label: Prefer Catch-up As Primary
fields.helper_text: Prefer eligible catch-up streams first, then apply resolution and playlist preferences.

fields.label: Exclude Disabled Groups From Master Selection
fields.helper_text: Avoid selecting master channels from disabled groups.

fields.label: Run Scrubber After Playlist Sync
fields.helper_text: Let the native scrubber refresh health state after playlist sync.

fields.label: Scrubber-aware Primary Selection
fields.helper_text: Exclude channels confirmed dead by the scrubber when choosing the primary channel.

fields.label: Existing User-managed Scrubber
fields.helper_text: Leave blank for GuideLink to create and manage a scrubber. A selected user-managed scrubber is audited without changing it.

fields.label: Scan Disabled Channels
fields.helper_text: Keeps last_scrubber_live fresh for disabled failover-topology channels so native auto-merge can recover them safely.

fields.label: Rebuild Failovers After Scan
fields.helper_text: After a successful scrubber scan, rerun native auto-merge with fresh health state so promotions and failover recovery stay topology-aware.

fields.label: Scrubber Probe Method
fields.helper_text: Fast HTTP probing is usually enough; use FFprobe only when provider behavior requires it.

fields.label: Scrubber Probe Timeout Seconds
fields.helper_text: Per-stream native scrubber timeout.

fields.label: Matching
fields.description: Advanced matcher thresholds. Defaults are conservative and should normally be left alone.

ui_tables.label: Playlists
ui_tables.delete_description: This clears the GuideLink profile and disables this playlist assignment without removing the playlist from the table.

fields.label: Playlist
fields.helper_text: Prefilled from your playlists. This row controls GuideLink behavior for the selected playlist.

fields.label: Profile
fields.helper_text: Choose an enabled GuideLink profile. Leave empty to keep the playlist unassigned.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.helper_text: Enable this playlist assignment before setup, reports, sync, or schedules will use it.

fields.label: Run Sync
fields.helper_text: Allow scheduled or assigned-playlist sync actions to include this playlist.

fields.label: Run Availability
fields.helper_text: Allow scheduled or assigned-playlist availability checks to include this playlist.

ui_tables.label: Results
ui_tables.description: Native audit rows from plugin runs.

ui_tables.label: Alias Sets
ui_tables.description: Choose read-only bundled defaults or create a custom set, then attach it to profiles. Use Preview Alias Set in the Actions menu to inspect its entries. Bundled data is replaced with the plugin ZIP.

fields.label: Bundled Defaults
fields.helper_text: Choose a read-only dataset, or leave empty to manage this set in Aliases. Plugin updates replace bundled data directly. Preview its contents using Preview Alias Set.

fields.label: Reference Guide EPG
fields.helper_text: Used to choose channel targets. Profiles can reuse this set with guides containing the same stream IDs and matching channel names.

ui_tables.label: Aliases
ui_tables.description: Editable alternative names for custom sets. Read-only bundled defaults are not stored here; use Preview Alias Set to inspect them.

fields.label: Custom Alias Sets
fields.helper_text: Share this entry across compatible custom sets. Bundled defaults are read-only and cannot be edited here.

fields.label: Alternative Channel Names
fields.helper_text: One full channel name per tag. Add +1 names separately against their own guide entry.

fields.label: Run For Assigned Playlists
fields.helper_text: Run this action for every enabled playlist assignment instead of one selected playlist.

fields.label: Playlist
fields.helper_text: Uses the assigned profile to preview native auto-merge, managed scrubber, and channel metadata changes. Does not start a scan.
